fixed.explanation: With LIMIT 0, TopNHeap has heap_size 0, so Sink still runs EntryShouldBeAdded, which reads heap.front() on an empty vector. AddEntryToHeap then calls pop_heap and pop_back on that empty vector, and the final boundary update reads heap.front() again. All three are undefined behavior and can corrupt memory. The edit returns early from Sink when heap_size is 0, so the heap is never touched. I haven't run this, and the diagnosis comes from reading the code.
